title: SS14-faithful 3D EVA suit, helmet, masks and oxygen tanks
scope: art-only; replace the rejected, unaccepted wearable placeholders/adaptations; no gameplay/code or unrelated wearables
target_runtime: Minecraft Java 1.21.1 / NeoForge 21.1.224; authored worn meshes consumed by the existing AuthoredWearableMesh/EquipmentRenderPlan contracts
dependencies: Existing runtime wearable IDs, AuthoredWearableMesh/EquipmentRenderPlan renderer and canonical humanoid anchors; do not add slots/framework or alter inventory icons.
brief: Create professional, source-faithful replacements for all six listed worn visuals as one cohesive family. The current models are rejected/unaccepted placeholders, not approved artwork. Follow the pinned SS14 EVA helmet/suit, breathing mask and oxygen-tank designs; see docs/eva-internals-sprint/WEARABLE-MODEL-BRIEF.md for visual and review requirements. Helmet attaches to HEAD with shell depth and clear visor; raised breathing mask reads distinctly on HEAD/mouth and lowered state sits at lower neck/TORSO; suit follows TORSO plus paired articulated arms and legs, with clean seams, broad WIDE-body fit, no Minecraft armor-cube chunks or clipping/occlusion; tanks are recognizable faceted SS14 oxygen forms, placed only in body-worn/back, suit-storage or belt positions supported by current contracts. Preserve separation between held/inventory icons and worn meshes; icons are unchanged and are not proof of 3D completion. Provide modeler previews front/side/back plus walking and arm/leg articulation, showing both mask states. Deliver editable source, complete runtime asset group and per-file provenance/license through the canonical asset workflow; do not place models/previews in docs. Cite pinned upstream source in attribution. Delivery is not acceptance/import.
